name: Campingpark Oberammergau
beschreibung: The Campingpark Oberammergau is located in the municipality of Oberammergau in the district of Garmisch-Partenkirchen, Bayern, Deutschland. The surroundings are characterized by the Bayerischen Alpen with numerous hiking trails and ski areas such as the Laber and the Kolben. The site is situated quietly and close to nature between forest and mountain meadows. The facilities include pitches for motorhomes and caravans, sanitary buildings with showers and toilets, electricity connections as well as a supply and disposal station. The year-round opening allows use in summer and winter. Nearby are a restaurant and a grocery store. Guests can use the surrounding mountains for hiking, cycling or skiing.
